title: Field Marketing Specialist
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Japan Field Marketing Specialist will work closely with the Head of Japan Field Marketing to  lead and execute strategic programs with cross-functional teams to build the overall pipeline in Japan . This plan will proceed in close alignment with Sales Directors, Inside Sales, Partner/Channel Sales, and the broader Go-to-Market team. This role will drive the execution of events and campaigns and create business value in collaboration with partners. This position reports directly to the Head of Japan Field Marketing.

This position serves as one of the primary liaisons between the SDR team, the Field Sales team, and the Marketing team. This role aims to increase brand awareness, generate demand, and achieve targets utilizing a wide variety of marketing methods and strategies, including account-targeted programs, trade shows, conferences, specific field events, campaigns and assets, direct mail, webinars, and workshops. 

The primary objective of this position is to acquire new customers, nurture leads into the sales pipeline, and accelerate the sales cycle for prospects more efficiently through the execution of marketing programs.

What you’ll be doing

• Collaborate with the Field Marketing Team and Partner Marketing Team to independently lead and execute various events, programs, and campaigns to support Okta's achievement of sales targets. Also, support the management of lead generation through closure across all activities and maintain the balance of pipeline goals.

• Plan and execute the management of materials for campaigns, programs, and events, exhibit materials, local and online events, and sales/field events, in coordination with the Head of Japan Field Marketing. Promote activities by working closely with the Sales team and SDRs during pre-event preparations to gain support for event success.

• Execute event strategies and plans, and project manage the overall logistics of participating events, on-site execution, and post-event results analysis.

• Collaborate with various vendor teams to drive the planning and execution of projects and events.

• Communicate with teams such as Sales, SE (Solutions Engineers), Inside Sales, and, if necessary, the APJ Marketing team, functioning as a primary liaison.

• Increase brand awareness and generate demand using a wide variety of marketing methods in Japan, including account-targeted programs, trade shows, conferences, events, campaigns, direct mail, and webinars.

• Effectively collaborate cross-functionally to define, project manage, and execute event program goals, messaging, tactics, audience generation email campaigns, speaker plans, collateral creation, post-event lead processing and follow-up, and all other general logistics.

• Measure and analyze the results of marketing activities and the health of the pipeline. Additionally, collect post-event feedback and create post-event reports and analysis.

What you’ll bring to the role:

• Experience in marketing activities driving demand generation, event planning to execution, and campaign management, within B2B or B2C marketing.

• An expert in multi-tasking, prioritization, and schedule management, with consistent proven results and experience in complex event programs involving partners, multiple product lines, and diverse cross-functional teams within the organization.

• Ability to effectively plan, execute, and report on marketing programs in collaboration with internal and external partners

Preferred Qualifications

Operational Preferred

The Affiliate Manager is responsible for growing CoinPoker 's poker affiliate book in the region, with a primary focus on sourcing, negotiating, and closing new affiliate deals, alongside the ongoing management and commercial performance of the existing partner book.
The role is focused on identifying and closing new affiliate opportunities, structuring deals to attract players whose volume and longevity justify their cost, and cutting or renegotiating underperforming or low-quality sources quickly.

• Proven track record sourcing and closing poker affiliate deals, with the acquisition and rake numbers to show for it and the ability to explain the commercial decisions behind them.

• Established relationships within the regional poker affiliate and community landscape, or a demonstrated ability to build them quickly.

• Strong working knowledge of poker affiliate deal structures, including CPA, rev share, rakeback-based, and hybrid arrangements.

• Demonstrated experience monitoring cohort quality, rake generation, and player longevity, and renegotiating or cutting deals based on the data.

• Strong negotiation and commercial judgment, with experience operating within guardrails and knowing when to escalate.

• Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.

About Team / Role

The Territory Sales Manager role at WEX FSM is a strategic, quota-carrying sales position focused on driving high-impact growth across an assigned territory. You will lead complex sales cycles with small to mid-sized HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical contractors while mentoring less experienced sellers and contributing to broader territory strategy. In this role, you’ll bring proven success and industry acumen to win larger, multi-location, or high-value accounts, help shape sales best practices, and prepare for future leadership roles. How you’ll make an impact

Territory Growth & Strategic Selling

• Own and execute a territory growth plan targeting larger or more complex contractor accounts.

• Cultivate strong, consultative relationships with owners and operational leaders, understanding their unique business needs and presenting tailored Payzer solutions.

• Navigate multistakeholder sales cycles with fluency across product lines: scheduling, invoicing, payments, financing, and reporting.

Full-Cycle Sales Execution

• Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery to solution presentation, proposal, and close.

• Drive outbound activity and manage inbound leads, with a focus on maximizing territory penetration and win rates.

• Maintain an accurate and up-to-date pipeline using Salesforce and sales engagement tools.

Ownership

• Partner with your Regional Sales Manager and Marketing to refine go-to-market strategies and feedback loops from the field.

• Actively contribute to improving sales processes, messaging, and playbooks through collaboration and data-informed insight.

Performance & Development

• Consistently obtain monthly and quarterly sales targets, with a focus on quality deals and long-term value.

• Take ownership of your professional growth by engaging in leadership development opportunities, advanced sales training, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Prepare for career advancement into roles such as Regional Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts, or Team Lead.

Experience you'll bring

• 2+ years of high-performing B2B sales experience, preferably in SaaS, fintech, or SMB technology markets.

• Deep understanding of the sales process and ability to tailor consultative approaches to various contractor business models.

• Comfortable mentoring and collaborating with junior sellers to raise overall team performance.

• Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Proficiency with Salesforce and sales engagement tools.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

About the Role
Realty.com is hiring an Inbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) to support our growing inbound demand. This is a high-volume, structured role focused on qualifying inbound leads, having productive conversations, and setting high-quality demos for our sales team.
This role is not closing-focused and not full-cycle sales . Success is measured by consistency, follow-through, and execution.
If you enjoy talking to people, can stay disciplined in a repeatable daily workflow, and want to build a long-term career in sales, this role offers strong training, clear expectations, and a defined growth path.

• Have structured qualification conversations using the provided scripts

• Identify customer intent and route leads appropriately

• Set qualified demos for Account Executives

• Track all activity accurately in our CRM

• Follow daily call, activity, and quality standards

• Stay focused, organized, and consistent throughout the day

This role involves a high volume of outbound calls to inbound leads . You will be on the phone daily.
What This Role Is (and Is Not)
This role is:

• Inbound-only (no cold prospecting)

• Process-driven and highly structured

• Entry-level and training-focused

• A stepping stone to more advanced sales roles

This role is not:

• A closing or Account Executive position

• Commission-only or high-ticket sales

• A “build your own book” role

• A fit for senior or full-cycle sales reps

Who We’re Looking For

• Early-career candidates or recent graduates

• Strong communicators who can stay calm and professional on the phone

• People who are comfortable with repetition and routine

• Coachable, reliable, and detail-oriented individuals

• Prior sales experience is not required - training is provided

Compensation & Growth

• Base salary with performance-based bonuses

• Clear expectations and measurable success metrics

• Opportunity to grow into advanced sales roles over time

Why Realty.com
Realty.com is a fast-growing real estate technology company focused on building scalable, data-driven sales systems. We value structure, clarity, and accountability, and we invest in people who want to grow within those systems.
Requirements
Requirements

• Strong verbal communication skills and comfort speaking on the phone daily

• Ability to follow scripts, processes, and daily activity expectations

• High level of organization and attention to detail

• Consistent work ethic and reliability

• Coachable mindset and openness to feedback

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

• Basic computer literacy and ability to learn CRM tools

Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Prior experience in sales, customer service, or call-center environments

• Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

• Interest in pursuing a long-term career in sales

This Role Is a Strong Fit If You

• Enjoy structured, repeatable work and clear expectations

• Can handle rejection and stay focused throughout the day

• Prefer being measured by effort and execution rather than guesswork

• Want to build foundational sales skills before moving into a closing role

This Role Is Not a Fit If You

• Are looking for a senior, closing, or full-cycle sales role

• Dislike being on the phone for a large portion of the day

• Need constant variety or unstructured work

• Are primarily motivated by uncapped commissions or high-ticket deals

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• College coursework or degree is a plus but not required

Highlights
Inbound-only sales role focused on qualifying leads and setting demos. Entry-level, structured, phone-based position with clear training, performance metrics, and a defined path to grow in sales.

title: Clinical Physician (Full-time or Part time)
description:
ABOUT OPTEXITY

Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models on data no other lab can reach. We deploy directly inside clinics and hospitals - including systems with no APIs, using integration infrastructure we've built and open-sourced - and in return become their preferred partner. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them.

We're a small, fast-moving founding team with multiple published papers in NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR and backgrounds from Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, CMU, and IIT.

We are backed by world-class investors and leaders including Jeff Dean, Neotribe VC, PearVC, Together Fund, and Zapier Fund.

HOW WE WORK

- Customer obsession - we start with the customer and work backwards

- Intellectual honesty - ideas matter more than titles; we communicate directly and assume good intent, even in disagreement

- Bias for action - we build and learn with customers rather than debate in the abstract

- Extreme ownership - we own outcomes, not just tasks, and see problems through

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We're building a clinical AI assistant that sits inside real practices - surfacing care gaps, assembling pre-visit prep, flagging risk, and suggesting treatment plans. None of that works without physicians defining what "correct" means.

Most clinical advisor roles are a monthly call where someone reacts to a demo. This one isn't. You'll be in the product loop weekly: deciding what the assistant should flag, what a good summary actually looks like at 7:50am before a 15-minute visit, and grading where the model is wrong and why. Your judgment becomes our ground truth and our evaluation standard.

We're looking for physicians across internal medicine, cardiology, oncology, and other specialties - both to go deep in your own domain and to help us understand where workflows diverge across specialties.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Define what the assistant should surface. Which care gaps matter, which risk signals are worth an interruption, and which are noise that erodes trust. Translate clinical shorthand into precise, checkable criteria.

- Shape the pre-visit summary. What belongs in it, in what order, at what length - and what a physician actually reads versus scrolls past.

- Specify clinical search. What you'd want to pull from the chart before a visit, how you'd phrase it, and what a complete answer looks like.

- Judge the AI. Review model-generated risk flags, differentials, and treatment plans against your own reasoning. Score them, explain the gap, and tell us whether a miss is dangerous or merely different.

- Build ground truth. Help us construct real-case evaluation sets and rubrics that reflect actual standard of care, not textbook answers.

- Pressure-test the product. Sit in on design decisions and tell us when something wouldn't survive contact with a real clinic day.

- Contribute to publications. We publish benchmarks and technical reports; clinical co-authorship is available and encouraged.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

- MD or DO, board-certified or board-eligible

- Currently practicing or recently practicing - active clinical context matters more than titles

- Internal medicine, cardiology, oncology, or an adjacent specialty; primary care and multi-specialty experience especially welcome

- Day-to-day fluency in an EMR (Epic, eClinicalWorks, Athena, ModMed, or similar) and an honest view of where it fails you

- Opinionated about clinical workflow, and able to explain why something is right - not just that it is

- Comfortable with ambiguity, direct feedback, and being asked "how do you actually know that?"

- Genuinely interested in AI in medicine, including its failure modes

NICE TO HAVE

- Clinical informatics training or CMIO-adjacent experience

- Experience with quality measures and value-based care programs (HEDIS, MIPS, CPT Category

Bonus Skills

• Experience working on large-scale B2B SaaS platforms.

• Background in chaos engineering, resilience testing, performance testing, load testing, or incident learning programs.

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO, SOC 2, GDPR , FEDRAMP/ CMMC ).

title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
 
Loft Orbital is looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Lead to help scale the way we build spacecraft.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role combining technical leadership with direct Manufacturing Engineering execution. You’ll spend approximately half of your time providing technical direction, prioritizing work, and mentoring Manufacturing Engineers, while remaining deeply involved in the day-to-day engineering required to build, troubleshoot, and improve our spacecraft production processes.

You’ll work directly on the production floor and partner closely with AIT, Design Engineering, Production Planning, Supply Chain, and Quality to translate spacecraft designs into robust, repeatable manufacturing processes. From developing work instructions and tooling to resolving production issues and improving manufacturability, you’ll personally own engineering work while helping the broader team operate effectively and scale.
 
What Success Looks Like:

You’ll be successful in this role by being equally comfortable leading the team and doing the work yourself.
You’ll help Manufacturing Engineers prioritize and solve difficult problems while personally developing processes, supporting technicians, troubleshooting production issues, and driving spacecraft builds forward. Over time, your work will help turn spacecraft designs into increasingly repeatable, scalable, and production-ready manufacturing processes, enabling Loft to increase production capacity without compromising the quality and reliability required for flight hardware.

 *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

• Build robust evaluation infrastructure : Create and maintain eval suites drawn from real-world scenarios and edge cases. • Experiment and prototype : Keep up with the latest in NLP, agentic systems, and generative AI. Our agents already handle tens of thousands of real customer conversations every hour, so your work has immediate, visible impact.

• Drive technical decisions : Scope your own work, push back when the framing is wrong, and tell us when the plan needs to change.

We're looking for a Financial Analyst, FP&A to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis across corporate and site-level cost centers. En Fundación Capital, brindamos la oportunidad de impactar positivamente la vida de millones de personas a nivel global. Ofrecemos un entorno dinámico y colaborativo, donde la innovación y el compromiso social son el motor de nuestras acciones.

Tipo de contrato: Prestación de servicios profesionales por honorarios.

Sobre nosotros:

Somos una organización social sin fines de lucro, comprometida en transformar la realidad financiera de personas que viven en situación de pobreza. • Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.

• Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.

• Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.

• Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.

description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Location: Lawrenceville/Loganville/Hoschton/Peachtree Corners, GA

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $90,000-$120,000/year

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Pediatric Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) to join our team. In this role, you will evaluate and treat children with a wide range of speech, language, and feeding/swallowing needs, working closely with families to guide them in understanding their child's areas of need and strengths. A central part of this position is helping families support their child's intervention and carryover of skills at home, at school, and in the community, ensuring progress made in session translates into everyday life.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct comprehensive speech, language, articulation, fluency, voice, and feeding/swallowing evaluations for pediatric clients

• Develop individualized treatment plans with measurable goals based on assessment findings and each child's developmental level

• Provide direct, evidence-based therapy for a caseload of pediatric clients with diverse communication and feeding disorders

• Guide families in understanding their child's areas of need and strengths, translating clinical findings into clear, actionable information

• Partner with parents and caregivers to support carryover of skills and strategies at home, at school, and in the community

• Coordinate and communicate with teachers, pediatricians, occupational and physical therapists, and other providers involved in the child's care

• Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation, including evaluation reports, SOAP notes, progress notes, and insurance-required paperwork

• Track client progress toward goals on an ongoing basis and adjust treatment plans as needed

• Participate in team meetings, case conferences, and school-based meetings (e.g., IEP/IFSP) as needed

• Educate parents and caregivers on home exercise programs, strategies, and tools to reinforce therapy outside of sessions

• Stay current with best practices, research, and continuing education in pediatric speech-language pathology

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology from a program accredited by the Council on Academic Accreditation (CAA)

• Active Georgia state license in Speech-Language Pathology (or eligibility to obtain), and ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP)

• Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience working with pediatric clients across a range of speech, language, and feeding/swallowing disorders

• Strong understanding of child development and evidence-based assessment and treatment approaches for pediatric communication and feeding disorders

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build rapport with children and explain clinical concepts clearly and empathetically to parents and caregivers

• Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and to coordinate treatment carryover across home, school, and community settings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supervising Clinical Fellows (CFs) or graduate student clinicians

• Specialized training or certification (e.g., PROMPT, feeding and swallowing certifications, AAC)

• Bilingual or multilingual skills

• Prior experience in a private practice or pediatric outpatient setting

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

• Electronic health record / practice management systems (e.g., SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, WebPT, or similar)

• Standardized assessment tools (e.g., CELF, PLS-5, GFTA, or comparable pediatric speech/language batteries)

• Teletherapy platforms for virtual sessions, where applicable

• Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) devices and apps

• Microsoft Office / Google Workspace for documentation, scheduling, and reporting

description:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand, engage, and retain customers at scale.
Unlike traditional platforms that stop at reporting and dashboards, Lucidya combines proprietary AI, deep language understanding, and autonomous workflows to help organizations move from insight to action. Our technology is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual customer conversations, enabling brands across the MENA region to make better decisions, deliver better experiences, and build stronger customer relationships.
As AI reshapes how businesses operate, we're building products that make customer understanding faster, more accurate, and more actionable than ever before.
Why This Role Matters
Most organizations today are overwhelmed with customer data.
Conversations are happening across social media, surveys, reviews, support tickets, messaging channels, and countless other touchpoints. The challenge isn't collecting the data anymore. It's knowing what matters and what to do next.
The Monitoring & Research domain sits at the center of that challenge.
This is where customers come to understand public perception, identify emerging trends, monitor competitors, measure customer sentiment, and uncover the insights that drive business decisions. It is one of the most strategically important parts of Lucidya 's platform and one of the biggest opportunities for innovation as AI transforms how research and customer intelligence are done.
As Senior Product Manager, you'll be responsible for shaping how thousands of users discover, trust, and act on insights generated from millions of customer conversations.
You'll be joining a team that values ownership over hierarchy, customer outcomes over feature output, and learning over certainty. We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and expect product leaders to bring strong opinions while remaining open to changing their minds when the evidence says otherwise.
If you're excited by complex customer problems, AI-powered products, and the opportunity to define the future of customer intelligence in a region where world-class solutions are still emerging, this role will give you significant room to make an impact.

Own the future of Monitoring & Research at Lucidya

• Social Listening

Your responsibility isn't simply delivering features. It's ensuring customers can confidently answer critical business questions about their customers, markets, competitors, and brand performance.
Turn customer signals into decisions

You'll use those learnings to build products that help customers move beyond reporting and toward clear recommendations, meaningful insights, and measurable business outcomes.
Lead discovery before delivery
You'll challenge assumptions, validate problems, and ensure we're solving issues that matter before resources are committed.
You'll regularly engage customers, prospects, Customer Success teams, and internal stakeholders to uncover opportunities and validate product direction.
Success in this role means building the right thing, not simply building things quickly.
Raise the quality bar for AI-powered insights
As AI becomes increasingly central to our platform, you'll help define what "trustworthy AI" means in practice.
You'll work closely with AI, Data, Design, and Engineering teams to improve:

• Explainability

• Relevance

• Customer trust

You'll constantly ask whether an insight is genuinely useful, not just technically impressive.

title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer, Real-Time 3D Tracking
description:
Full-Time · Remote (Canada) · Eterio Realities Inc. / Fabstation

[Salary range: $ 160,000 - 200,000 CAD

About the Role

Fabstation puts AR work instructions directly onto structural steel during fabrication. Our software runs on AR tablets and headsets on real shop floors across North America, overlaying CAD-driven guidance onto multi-tonne steel assemblies during fit-up, welding, and inspection. We are cash-flow positive, growing fast, and used daily in production.

We are hiring a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to own our real-time 3D object tracking capability : locking a CAD model onto a physical steel member and keeping it locked as the user moves around it. Tracking is core to our product, and we build it in-house.

You will build on internal groundwork already underway and own the road from there: architecture, implementation, optimization, and production hardening. This is a role for someone who wants to own a hard, central problem end-to-end and see it shipped into the hands of real tradespeople, not maintain someone else's pipeline.

What You'll Do

• Own the on-device object tracking core end-to-end, from architecture through production

• Design and implement real-time, model-based 6DoF pose estimation and continuous tracking for textureless steel structures, using CAD models as the tracking reference

• Fuse object tracking with platform world tracking (visual-inertial odometry), depth, and IMU data; own tracking-loss detection, drift management, and recovery

• Optimize native C++ vision pipelines for iOS and Apple silicon: rendering, CPU/GPU budgets, and sustained frame rates on iPad or headset hardware

• Extend tracking to large structures: partial visibility, multi-region strategies, and CAD mesh preprocessing from IFC/STEP - type exports

• Integrate native modules with Unity via a plugin bridge, and work with our Unity team from prototype through release

• Define tracking quality metrics and benchmark against real shop-floor conditions: occlusion, mixed lighting, and cluttered scenes of visually similar material

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional experience in computer vision or a closely related field, with a focus on real-time systems

• Shipped at least one real-time computer vision feature on a mobile platform (iOS or Android)

• Strong modern C++; Python is an asset

• Solid foundation in 3D geometry: camera models, calibration, projective geometry, and linear algebra

• Working command of nonlinear least-squares optimization (Gauss-Newton / Levenberg-Marquardt) and pose parameterization on SE(3)

• Hands-on experience with pose estimation and object tracking algorithms

• Experience integrating native C++ libraries with Unity, or equivalent native-mobile plugin experience

• Strong profiling and optimization skills on ARM (frame budgets, Instruments or equivalent)

• Working proficiency with OpenCV

Preferred Qualifications

• Model-based 3D object tracking (region-based, edge-based, or hybrid approaches)

• Metal and GPU compute on Apple silicon

• Visual-inertial odometry or SLAM; ARKit (ARCore an asset)

• State estimation and multi-sensor fusion: Kalman filtering, factor graphs (Ceres, g2o, GTSAM), extrinsic calibration, and time synchronization

• On-device ML deployment: Core ML, ONNX Runtime, or Unity Sentis; learning-based pose estimation or refinement that has shipped on-device

• CAD data handling: mesh processing and decimation, IFC/STEP-style exports

• Background in industrial vision, robotics, or augmented reality

How to Apply

We prioritize applications that demonstrate hands-on, real-time computer vision work. Please include:

• A brief introduction and a summary of relevant experience

• Links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or publications

• One or two examples of real-time pose estimation, tracking, or 3D vision work you built, links or short write-ups

As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best-serving great food-by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

We're looking for a strategic, AI and data-driven Senior Revenue Enablement Program Manager to accelerate the performance of our Revenue organization. The Enablement team sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations and is responsible for driving AI strategy across revenue-facing teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who's excited about where AI can take us and has real-world experience using tools like Claude and GPT in their day-to-day workflow.

You won't just deliver training - you'll design scalable systems that improve execution quality, shorten sales cycles, increase win rates, and elevate seller confidence.

title: Staff AI Engineer - AI Labs
description:
Why Join dLocal?dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets-moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.
 

What's the Opportunity?
You will join the AI Lab, a team whose mission is to validate high-value emerging AI and automation technologies and de-risk their adoption across dLocal. This is a rare opportunity to work at the frontier of applied AI in fintech: running rigorous experiments on the latest models and tools, and turning results into decisions that shape how a global payments company adopts AI.
This is a senior individual-contributor role. It does not require direct people management, but it carries significant technical influence within the Lab and across the teams that consume its work.
As a Staff AI Engineer in the AI Lab, you own technology scouting, prototyping, and evaluation for dLocal. You will run instrumented spikes and benchmarking on emerging AI technologies, produce clear recommendations for stakeholders across engineering, business, legal and IT based on your prototypes, and coordinate hand-offs to the teams that take validated technologies into production.
For promising technologies, you will help define the patterns, guardrails, and technical requirements needed for adoption and coordinate the hand-off to the engineering teams responsible for productionizing them.
 

What do we offer? Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
- Flexibility in how you work: We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.
- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
- Work From Anywhere: Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year.
 
 
What happens after you apply?
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!
 
Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

title: Property Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Property Maintenance Coordinator
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Property Maintenance Coordinator to oversee maintenance operations across residential and commercial properties.
This is a fast-paced, coordination-focused role where you’ll manage maintenance requests, schedule vendors, track work orders, and ensure timely resolution of repairs. You’ll serve as the central point of communication between tenants, vendors, property managers, and ownership teams to keep maintenance operations running efficiently.
Responsibilities
Maintenance Coordination

• Receive, prioritize, and manage maintenance requests.

• Create and track work orders using property management systems.

• Monitor requests from intake through completion.

• Prioritize urgent maintenance issues and ensure timely resolution.

Vendor Management

• Schedule vendors, contractors, and technicians for repairs and inspections.

• Coordinate timelines and confirm service appointments.

• Verify vendor documentation, licensing, and compliance.

• Follow up to ensure work is completed on schedule.

Tenant Communication

• Communicate maintenance updates and scheduling with tenants.

• Provide timely follow-ups throughout the repair process.

• Confirm satisfaction after work is completed.

• Escalate emergency or unresolved issues when necessary.

Preventive Maintenance

• Schedule recurring maintenance, inspections, and preventive services.

• Maintain preventive maintenance calendars and tracking systems.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

• Support long-term property maintenance initiatives.

Documentation & Reporting

• Maintain accurate maintenance records, invoices, and work orders.

• Ensure documentation is complete and audit-ready.

• Track maintenance costs, vendor performance, and resolution times.

• Prepare maintenance reports for leadership.

Required Experience & Skills

• 2+ years of experience in property management, maintenance coordination, or facilities operations.

• Experience using Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi, or similar property management software.

• Experience coordinating vendors and managing work orders.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting multiple properties or portfolios of 100+ units.

• Knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or general building systems.

• Familiarity with OSHA, safety standards, or property compliance requirements.

• Experience implementing preventive maintenance programs.

• Residential, commercial, or multifamily property management experience.

What Success Looks Like

• Maintenance requests are resolved within SLA timelines.

• High tenant satisfaction with maintenance services.

• Vendors complete work accurately and on schedule.

• Maintenance documentation remains accurate and organized.

• Preventive maintenance is completed consistently.

• Minimal overdue or unresolved work orders.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager - Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.
Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements.

title: Freelance ERP Program Manager Finance
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Programme Manager ERP Financier
Le Programme Manager ERP Financier prend en charge le pilotage global d’un programme ERP dans sa composante financière. Il veille à l’alignement entre les besoins métier, le cahier des charges et les solutions techniques mises en place, tout en garantissant la cohérence du programme à travers ses différentes phases et parties prenantes.
Dans ce rôle, vous collaborez étroitement avec les interlocuteurs clés de la finance et de l’IT, et vous assurez une communication de gouvernance claire jusqu’au niveau de direction.
Responsabilités principales

• Piloter le programme ERP de bout en bout : cadrage, planification, suivi budgétaire et reporting aux parties prenantes.

• Recueillir, structurer et challenger les besoins métier afin de garantir une traduction correcte des exigences business dans la solution cible.

• Coordonner les équipes projet : experts finance, IT, intégrateurs et éditeurs, en arbitrant les priorités et les dépendances.

• Assurer la gouvernance du programme et communiquer de manière efficace avec les décideurs et les parties prenantes de niveau exécutif.

• Gérer les risques, les escalades et la continuité globale du programme.

• Veiller à la conformité des livrables avec les exigences réglementaires, le cahier des charges, les règles de marchés publics et les standards financiers applicables.

• Accompagner la transformation digitale et la conduite du changement auprès des équipes finance et de la direction.

• Garantir une bonne articulation entre l’ERP et les environnements existants, y compris lorsqu’un contexte mainframe fait partie du paysage applicatif.

📝 Votre profil

• Vous disposez d’une formation de niveau Bac+5 en finance, ingénierie ou école de commerce.

• Vous justifiez d’une expérience significative en gestion de programmes SI en environnement financier, avec au moins 15 ans d’expérience.

• Vous avez occupé une fonction de Senior Program Manager ou un rôle équivalent dans des organisations de grande taille.

• Vous maîtrisez un ERP majeur tel que SAP, Oracle ou Microsoft Dynamics.

• Vous possédez une solide expérience des business requirements, de la gouvernance programme et du pilotage de parties prenantes de niveau C-level.

• Vous avez une expertise avérée en change management, transformation digitale et coordination de programmes complexes.

• Vous avez une expérience confirmée du secteur public, idéalement dans le contexte d’une grande ville.

• Vous connaissez en profondeur la comptabilité communale belge, en particulier les processus détaillés de dépenses, recettes et budget d’une grande ville.

• Vous comprenez les enjeux de marchés publics et savez intégrer ces contraintes dans le pilotage du programme.

• Vous faites preuve d’excellentes capacités de communication, d’un leadership naturel et d’un très bon sens de l’organisation.

title: Prior Authorization Pharmacy Technician
description:

Job Purpose:
In this role, the individual will support patient care by removing barriers to medication access. This includes working with insurance companies and clinician offices to facilitate medication approvals through prior authorizations, as well as collaborating with patients and various funding sources, such as foundations or pharmaceutical manufacturers, to obtain financial assistance for high-cost copays. You’ll serve as the primary relationship owner for key partners, working cross-functionally with product, engineering, finance, legal, operations, and corporate development to ensure partnerships are healthy, scalable, and aligned with Gusto’s long-term strategy.
